sections.A: ACL ghutne ke andar ek mazboot ligament hai jo pindli ki haddi ko aage khisakne aur ghoomne se rokta hai. Aksar mudne ya utarne ki chot se phatta hai.
sections.B: Achanak mudna, utarna ya rukna, aksar 'pop' ki aawaz ke saath, aur ghanton mein tezi se sujan. Baad mein ghutna 'nikal jane' ka ehsaas.
sections.C: Chot kaise lagi, pop suna, sujan kitni jaldi aayi, aur kya ghutna giving way karta hai.
sections.D: Sujan, neel, chaal, effusion, range aur quadriceps dekhein. Nerves aur khoon check karein.
sections.E: Lachman sab se ahem test hai. Patient relaxed ho to tests zyada accurate hote hain, is liye kabhi sujan kam hone ke baad dobara test karein.
sections.F: Meniscus tear, MCL sprain aur chapni ka utarna isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Kai directions mein dheela-pan aur bohat sujan (multiligament ya ghutna utarna), ya pair thanda aur nabz kamzor: emergency.
sections.H: Red flags na hon; chot ka tareeqa, tezi se sujan aur positive Lachman: ACL injury. Phir surgery ya exercise ka faisla patient ke saath.
sections.I: Chapni ki mobilisation aur soft tissue kaam taa ke ghutna akde na aur extension wapas aaye.
sections.J: Hafton ke bajaye criteria se aage barhein. Pehle sujan control, poori extension aur quadriceps; phir taaqat, balance, daurna aur khel.
sections.K: Shuru mein thand aur compression; quadriceps ke liye NMES madadgar ho sakta hai.
sections.L: Pehle safety, sujan control aur extension. Phir surgery ya non-surgical rehab ka faisla, aur khel par wapsi sirf tests pass karne ke baad.
sections.M: Sujan, range, quadriceps aur hamstring ki taaqat, hop tests aur khel ki tayyari dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 19 saal ke footballer ne utarte waqt pop suna aur 2 ghante mein ghutna sooj gaya. Khud socho, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: safety screen, sujan control, extension aur quadriceps, phir criteria par rehab.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
